thought.text: ASR service is up and healthy. Now triggering a fresh transcription for a live end-to-end validation.

reasoning_content:
ASR service is up and running. Next, let me trigger a new file. I'll copy test.wav under a new name and monitor it. The model load previously took about 1 minute, and the transcription took several minutes. I'll proceed with a 600-second budget.

Let me place the file and poll for about 9 minutes.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode/watch && cp test.wav recheck.wav && date && for i in $(seq 1 27); do sleep 20; if [ -f recheck.txt ]; then echo "TXT APPEARED at ~$((i*20))s"; break; fi; if ! docker ps --filter name=asr --format '{{.Status}}' | grep -q Up; then echo "ASR DIED at iteration $i"; break; fi; done; date; ls -la recheck.*

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode/watch && cp test.wav recheck.wav && date && for i in $(seq 1 27); do sleep 20; if [ -f recheck.txt ]; then echo \"TXT APPEARED at ~$((i*20))s\"; break; fi; if ! docker ps --filter name=asr --format '{{.Status}}' | grep -q Up; then echo \"ASR DIED at iteration $i\"; break; fi; done; date; ls -la recheck.*", "summary": "Drop new file and poll up to 9 min for transcript", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
